The '''Torragan Mountains''' were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range located over two thousand kilometers away to the southeast of the [[Shakamm Crater]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aurea]]. It was the location of the [[Dome of Crystal Fire]], a protected cave deep below the mountains containing burning crystals. The [[Eternal Furnace]], a giant lava pool used by the [[Aurean Glassworkers Guild]] for their most audacious and important projects, was also located in the mountains.
